title: Kadhal Kirukkan
desc: Saaravan falls in love after meeting with his childhood friend, Maha, and swears to protect her for the rest of his life.

title: Savaal
desc: Brothers Shankar and Raja decide to go to the city for better opportunities post their mother's death. However, they get separated while travelling on a goods train.

title: Idhayam
desc: When a medical student from a middle-class family falls in love with an affluent English-speaking pretty girl, he is unable to express his love to her due to his inferiority complex.

title: Harichandra
desc: A compulsive liar falls in love with an honest school principal. However, his habit of lying starts causing problems in their relationship.

title: Puli
desc: Marudheeran goes on a quest to bring back his love, Pavazhamalli, who was kidnapped by the Vedhalams, a group that possesses mystical powers. He must face Yavanarani, a sorceress, and her aide.
